title: Initial Release
subtitle: Official release of the plugin, with support for 2026.1 [1.21.8]!

title: The Living World
subtitle: Entity themed update, with 8 new procedure blocks, triggers, and bug fixes!

new_blocks.name: Make pet [ entity ] [SIT/STAND]
new_blocks.description: Makes the selected pet sit or stand.

new_blocks.name: Make [ source entity ] BackStab entity [ entity ] with offset x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Teleports the source entity behind the target entity using the specified positional offset, making it useful for backstab-style attacks.

new_blocks.name: Shake player [ entity ] camera with power [ x ] for [ x ] seconds
new_blocks.description: Shakes the selected player's camera with the specified intensity for the given duration.

new_blocks.name: Does [ entity ] have any [ Normal / Custom ] tasks
new_blocks.description: Checks whether the entity has normal AI tasks or tasks created by the Advanced Procedures plugin.

new_blocks.name: Is [ Entity ] [Climbing / Swinging MainHand / Swinging OffHand ]
new_blocks.description: Checks whether the entity is currently doing the specified action.

new_blocks.name: Loop through all blocks tagged as [ tag ] in radius [ x ] use position x: [ x ] y: [ x ] z: [ x ] use block [ iterator ]
new_blocks.description: Loops through all blocks with the specified tag within the given radius, starting from the nearest block.

new_blocks.name: Get [ Nearest / Furthest ] Block [ Block ] in distance [ x ]
new_blocks.description: Returns the position vector of the nearest or furthest matching block within the specified distance.

new_blocks.name: Run only after [ x ] [Ticks / Seconds] { }
new_blocks.description: Delays the execution of the blocks inside until the specified time has passed. Calls made before the delay finishes are ignored.
